versions.changelog: v1.1.0: Add gold/forex macro context, trending sentiment check, calendar awareness, update MCP endpoint

- Initial release of groundapi_a_share_analyst skill.
- Provides real-time A-share stock analysis with fundamentals, technicals, and recent news.
- Supports both individual stock and industry/sector analysis workflows.
- Requires GroundAPI MCP connection and environment key configuration.
- Structured and user-friendly report outputs in both single stock and sector cases.
- Includes built-in safeguards for unsupported markets, missing data, and always adds a disclaimer.
